# Descriptors that the level-rule programming path MUST
# refuse.  Roadmap section T2.1 requires an elaboration
#
# NOTE: under the adopted design (README S12) a level
# window is the full L1 of its rectangle, chunk_rows is
# fixed at the bank depth and chunk_base is always 0, so
# the non-pow2 / misaligned / over-capacity classes below
# are unreachable by construction and only the level
# bound survives as a real elaboration check.  They are
# kept because the reference still models the params.
# assert on chunk_base alignment; section T2.3 item 4 is
# the gate: an illegal-descriptor SVA must fire on
# unaligned / non-pow2 chunk_base / over-capacity.
#
# @format           teranoc-vc-illegal
# @version          1
# @geometry         terapool
# @words_per_bank   256
# @max_level        2
# @columns          reason k chunk_base chunk_rows
# k / chunk_base / chunk_rows are DECIMAL here; chunk_base and
# chunk_rows are word-planes.  The trailing text after '|' is the
# reference diagnostic, informative only.
#
non_pow2_chunk_extent   1      0      3 | chunk extent must be a power of two, got 3 rows
non_pow2_chunk_extent   1      0    255 | chunk extent must be a power of two, got 255 rows
misaligned_chunk_base   1      1     64 | INVARIANT #5: chunk_base 1 is not aligned to the 64-row chunk extent; chunk_base|chunk_row would fold the chunk onto itself
misaligned_chunk_base   1     32     64 | INVARIANT #5: chunk_base 32 is not aligned to the 64-row chunk extent; chunk_base|chunk_row would fold the chunk onto itself
misaligned_chunk_base   0     65     64 | INVARIANT #5: chunk_base 65 is not aligned to the 64-row chunk extent; chunk_base|chunk_row would fold the chunk onto itself
over_capacity           1    256     64 | over-capacity: chunk_base 256 + 64 rows exceeds the 256-word bank depth
